claims.text: Social appearance anxiety is positively related to social media addiction in adolescents.
Social appearance anxiety is negatively related to mindful awareness in adolescents.
Mindful awareness is negatively related to social media addiction in adolescents.
Mindful awareness partially mediates the relationship between social appearance anxiety and social media addiction in adolescents.

evidence.description: In a sample of 383 secondary school students, social appearance anxiety was positively related to social media addiction.
Standardized measures administered to 383 students showed social appearance anxiety was negatively related to mindful awareness.
Survey results from 383 participants demonstrated that mindful awareness was negatively related to social media addiction.
Mediation analysis testing mindful awareness as a mediator between social appearance anxiety and social media addiction indicated partial mediation.

methodologies.name: Mediation analysis using standardized survey measures
methodologies.description: Cross-sectional survey assessing social appearance anxiety, mindful awareness, and social media addiction using standardized instruments to evaluate mediation.
datasets: Survey data from 383 volunteer secondary school students in eastern Türkiye
